I answered Pree in the thread on her #central-team message: the store is **Pine Crossing**.

The source is her own post in #central-team on 9 Jun 2026. She wrote that the morning receiver at Pine Crossing said the appointment screen only showed the afternoon shift. Hollis replied that he'd check the shift template and ask support to reproduce the problem with the store login. I couldn't find anything after that saying whether it was fixed, and I told her so.

I only checked places Pree can see herself: #central-team, #central-random, #inc-tansley-carrier-api and the public Central team files. I didn't use message search.
